introHtml: Spec duffle gym bags are built for heavy use, with reinforced stitching and water-resistant materials that stand up to daily commutes and weekend trips. Whether you are outfitting a sales team or stocking a company store, these bags offer large main compartments and multiple pockets for organized storage. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery to add your logo on the side panel or front pocket. The Drift Duffle and Weekender Duffle are popular choices for corporate gifts and employee incentives.
